scope: Offline deterministic state/contract demonstration; not independent agent evaluation or a production monitor

reference.licence: CC BY 4.0; AIHW attribution retained in reference
reference.lineage: Separately implemented Python selection from original publisher files, independent of production JavaScript. Same underlying publisher datasets; not independent verification of statistical collection.

checks.name: Original aggregate specimen has complete 8 × 5 coverage
Unchanged annual data remains valid after 30 days
Publication window, unknown schedule and overdue month are distinct
checks.note: Times and 24-hour grace are constructed, not a claimed AIHW schedule.

checks.name: Original monthly zero and component total
Missing required month is coverage failure, not zero
checks.expected: Missing baseline month must produce a coverage incident; no numeric substitute.

checks.name: Explicit publisher suppression retains null and reason
checks.note: Constructed suppression, not present in the real 2024–25 reference.

checks.name: missing remains distinct from suppression and retrieval failure
unavailable remains distinct from suppression and retrieval failure
Suppression converted to zero is rejected
Wrong geography opens one immediate semantic incident
Incompatible units rejected
Mismatched period convention rejected
Well-formed but two-year financial period rejected
Finite but impossible percent rejected; an explicit observed zero is valid
Revision waits for reconciliation; timestamps alone do not change version
checks.note: Expected correction recorded; a failed reconciliation instead takes the semantic-failure path.

checks.name: New period identified separately from revision
checks.note: Constructed release dates and copied values, not real publisher data.

checks.name: HTTP-success partial table cannot pass completeness
HTTP-success outage HTML cannot pass parsing
Rate limit confirmation and persistent-alert deduplication
checks.note: Retry scheduling/Retry-After enforcement is specified, not implemented in this reducer.

checks.name: Failed refresh preserves last good evidence and successful sibling
checks.note: Sibling uses a constructed generic record set; preservation check, not a Wales contract test.

checks.name: Existing acknowledged incidents survive import and silence unchanged failures
checks.note: NZ later incident overrides older success; rehearsal does not change actual baseline.

checks.name: Recovery needs two spaced good checks and notifies once
Flapping and unverified candidate do not close an incident
Semantic escalation of acknowledged access outage emits once
Monitor failure uses checkpoint age, not an unchanged HTTP health response
checks.note: Independent scheduler not activated; clock inputs injected.

checks.name: Restart preserves incident and outbox; absent/corrupt checkpoint cannot reset alerts

limitations: Transport, schema and domain-specific validation are preconditions to observe(); caller must enforce them.
No distributed locking, scheduler, sender, production quarantine or checkpoint artifact API implemented.
Simulated outbox never sends messages; delivery exactly-once is not established.
Release-schedule grace values are illustrative, not measured publisher SLAs.
